title: HATS Project Definition
description: The portable description of a project: its objective, its team of deployed agents, and the shared tools that team can reach. Authored by the Project Designer, stored by the Project Server, executed by the Team Runner. Runtime state (kanban board, meetings, transcripts, telemetry) is deliberately NOT part of this document.

id.description: Project identifier. Doubles as the on-disk folder name.

goal.description: The objective injected into every agent's system prompt to keep thinking anchored.

humanName.description: What the agents call the human team lead.

team.description: The deployed agents that make up this team.

mcpServers.description: Shared MCP servers started for the whole team.

speechEnabled.description: Whether the Team Runner synthesises speech for agent replies.

autoAssignVisuals.description: Assign unused avatars and backgrounds to agents that have none.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what this team does, for other teams finding it. Defaults to the goal.

tags.description: What this team works on, for other teams finding it, e.g. 'billing', 'postgres'.

visits.description: Which teams this team's agents may visit, and which teams' agents it hosts. Nothing is allowed by default.

visitTo.description: Teams this team's agents may visit. "*" means any team in the installation.

hostFrom.description: Teams whose agents this team hosts. "*" means any team in the installation.

approval.description: Whether an allowed visit to this team goes ahead, or waits for one of its admins.

maxHours.description: The longest a visit out of this team, or into it, may last.

memoryHome.description: What visitors take home from this team: all they learned, only their result, or nothing.

revision.description: Incremented by the Project Server on every write. Send it back in If-Match style updates to detect concurrent edits.

examples.name: Acme Launch
examples.goal: Ship the Acme beta to 100 pilot customers by Q4.
